title: Frame Evidence:A Benchmark for Reference Frames and Visual Evidence in Multi-Image Spatial Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.19564v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A spatial answer depends on the reference frame specified in language and its supporting visual evidence. Item accuracy alone obscures whether correctness persists when either changes. We introduce Frame Evidence, a benchmark of 320 matched triplets and 960 Chinese multiple-choice questions from captured and rendered scenes. One family compares three grounded reference frames over fixed images. The other pairs image deletion annotated as insufficient with answer-preserving addition. Joint metrics require correct answers across all three frames and paired evidence variants. Across 20 configurations on 288 held-out questions, GPT three-shot reaches 50.00\% item accuracy, but the best three-frame group accuracy is 5/48 (10.42\%), reached by GPT two-shot. translated_title: 帧证据：多图像空间推理中参考框架与视觉证据的基准
translated_abstract: 空间问题的答案依赖于语言中指定的参考框架及其对应的视觉证据。仅凭单项准确率会掩盖当二者之一发生变化时正确性是否得以保持。我们提出了Frame Evidence，一个包含320组匹配三元组和960道中文选择题的基准，题目源自实拍与渲染场景。其中一个题族在固定图像上比较三种有依据的参考框架；另一个题族将标注为证据不足的图像删除与保持答案不变的图像添加相配对。联合指标要求在所有三种参考框架以及配对的证据变体下均给出正确答案。在288道保留题上的20种配置实验中，GPT三样本提示达到50.00%的单项准确率，但最佳的三框架组联合准确率仅为5/48（10.42%），由GPT两样本提示取得。少样本提示和任务特定适配能够提升单项准确率，却无法稳定提升联合正确性。输入对照实验揭示了图像在何种情况下支持匹配成功的作答。
tldr: 该论文提出Frame Evidence基准，通过320组匹配三元组和960道中文选择题联合考察多图像空间推理中参考框架与视觉证据的稳健性，发现现有模型单项准确率虽可达50%，但跨框架与跨证据的联合正确率骤降至约10%。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Frame Evidence, a benchmark of 320 matched triplets and 960 Chinese multiple-choice questions that jointly evaluates the robustness of reference frames and visual evidence in multi-image spatial reasoning, revealing that although models reach up to 50% item accuracy, their joint correctness across all frames and evidence variants drops to about 10%.
